content: Nawu Birrikuken Bininj Minj Kabirringehkerren.
Psalm 49
Kuhni ngurribekka ngudda ngurriwarlahkenh bininj rowk nawu kubolkbubuyika rowk ngurrihni. Kandibekka ngurridjalwern bininj rowk kore kondah kurorre ngurrihni.
Kandibekka nawu ngurridjalyeng dja mak nawu ngurriwohrnawohrnan. Kandibekka nawu ngurrikuken bininj, warridj nawu ngurrimarladj.
Ngaye won ngudberre kunwok manbu mayalimak. Kore kukangebeh ngardduk ngayime ba bu ngudda wanjh ngurrimayalibayhme.

Ngaye wanjh ngabenbekkabekkan bu bininj kabirriyolyolme kunwoybukkenh. Bu ngahdirri instrument nawu lyre kore ngawayini, wanjh kunu ngayolyolme kunwok manbu kanbukkabukkankenh ngad bininj rowk, dja ngayolyolme kore baleh kakarremenmenyime kunwok manbu kamenwarlkayindi.
Yiddok ngakelemen bu kunrayek kambebme ngardduk? Yiddok ngandihkelehme nawu birriwarre bininj bu ngandiwakbuyingun ngardduk?
Bedda nawu njalenjale kabenmarrkkan yiman nawu namakmak, dja kabirriburlumerren bu kabirriyime bedda birrikuken duninjh.
Minj nangale bininj kabayahme kunmalng nuye nabuyika bininj. Minj kakarremulewan kore God ba bu kabikukbayahme nabuyika ba bu kayawoyhdarrkiddi.
Bininj minj karribayahme kundarrkid bu djal nawern money karrikukkarrme. Dja larrk, minj karribayahme manbu kundarrkid.
Kunukka minj nangale bininj kakarremulewan nuye God ba bu kabibawon karrarrkid munguyh, dja minj karrowen bu kakuknudmen kore kumidj.

Bininj rowk kabirridowe. Bininj nawu birribengwarr dja mak bininj nawu birrikodjkuludjad, wanjh bedda rowk kabirridjaldowe. Kabindimarnekukbawon nawu kabirrikukkarrme dja birribuyika bininj kabirrimang rowk.
Yikahwi bininj nawu birringeykimuk wanjh kabirribolkngeybun ba kabolkngeykenhdan bedberre. Dja bonj, bedda warridj kabirridjaldowe dja kabirridjaldi kore kumidj munguyh munguyh.
Bininj nawu nawernhkuken minj kangehkerren, dja kahdjaldowen yiman kayime mayh.
Kuhni kabenmarnekurduyimerran bininj nawu kabirridjalburlumerren, dja mak bininj nawu kabindikadjung, dja kabindibekkabekkan bedberre.

Bedda rowk wanjh kabirridowerren yiman sheep yerreh, dja wanjh kabirrire kore kumidj. Kumekbe wanjh kundowikenh kabenmirndenahnan! Bedda wanjh bonj, kabirrikuknudmen kore kumidj. Minj kabirridurnden kore kururrkmak bedberre. Nawu birrimak bininj wanjh munguyh kabindimarnewohrnan nawu birriwarre.
Dja ngaye, wanjh God nganngehke kore kundowikenh, dja woybukkih nungka ngankimang ba ngahdi kore nungka.
Yuwn bu ngurrikangewarre bu ngurrinan bininj nawu kakukenworren, dja kadjehdjenkurrme kunkimuk.
Bu nungka karrowen, wanjh minj njale kakukkan kore kundowikenh. Minj kakukkarrme kore kanjdji kakolung.
Bu nawu nakuken bininj kahdarrkid wanjh kanjilngmak dja kaburlumerren. Bininj rowk kabirriburlume.
Bonj, nungka wanjh kare kore kundowikenh karohrok nawu birrikebmawahmeng birriyingkihdoweng. Minj kabirriyawoyhnan kore kabolkwolkan.
Bininj nawu kaburlumerren, bu minj kawernhburrbun kunmak, wanjh karohrok mayh nawu kadjaldowe.
